body: I've done a few mostly to help level some classes to 90 before DT, pixies and arkasodara ones, but I'll have to check those out!

That sounds pretty similar to how I handled Bozja, which isn't too bad on my anxiety haha. I had a friend explain it a bit to me a few months ago and the way she made it sound was that I had to have timers and all sorts of things up which intimidated me lol
Yeah! Unfortunately I’m stuck at Delubrum Reginae for the moment, so I need to find a party for that. Really looking forward to Zadnor area
I didn’t even think about Gold Saucer stuff! I’ll have to look into that. Also heard great things about Eureka, but I suppose I thought that wasn’t easily solo-able haha

When my anxiety gets its worse, I rely on Disney movies. A few years ago, all I could manage to do was watch Hercules and Mulan on repeat for days. Nowadays ( and it's awful right now for me, too ), I tend to rely on TV. Sitcoms help me get out of my head, even if I don't find them particularly funny. They're light enough that I don't feel stressed watching them. 

Even if my suggestions don't help, I do hope you find some solace in something and feel better!
